title: Marketplace areas share one pinned nav: Classifieds, Housing, Market and Store swap content beneath it
detail: Under the Frequency design a pinned area nav (components/frequency/members/marketplace/area-nav.tsx) is mounted by the Classifieds, Housing, Market and new Store layouts through MarketAreaPin. It sticks under the app header and reads the active door from the URL, so soft navigation re-highlights it and each route's loading skeleton fills only the space below. The page bodies and MarketplaceBar no longer draw their own area row there. The areas move into the app/(main)/(marketplace) route group one slice at a time so the group layout mounts ONE nav instance and crossing areas swaps only the content (Market and Store first, then Classifieds, then Housing; the group adds no URL segment).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const g='app/(main)/(marketplace)/layout.tsx';const grp=fs.existsSync(g)&&fs.readFileSync(g,'utf8').includes('MarketAreaPin');for(const d of ['market','classifieds','housing','store']){const inGroup=fs.existsSync('app/(main)/(marketplace)/'+d);const p='app/(main)/'+d+'/layout.tsx';const own=fs.existsSync(p)&&fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').includes('MarketAreaPin');if(!(inGroup&&grp)&&!own)bad.push(d+' does not pin the area nav')}if(!fs.existsSync('components/frequency/members/marketplace/area-nav.tsx'))bad.push('no area-nav');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1027: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when an area neither sits in the marketplace route group (whose layout pins the nav) nor mounts the pin itself.
